title: ws80211_utils and WirelessFrame: Mask out not allowed channel widths
description:
A band can support certain channel types (widths), but particular
frequencies within that band don't necessarily support all those
widths, sometimes for regulatory reasons or for being the top or
bottom of the band. Linux nl80211 has a way to retrieve that, which
works well for the 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands.

For the 6 GHz band, at least on my card, it doesn't bother reporting
whether the secondary frequency has to be above or below the current
frequency (HT40MINUS vs PLUS), even though only one is supported under
standard 6 GHz operation to have non-overlapping channels (much like
VHT 80 MHz and above.) So we'll need some extra changes later.
